Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Discord dans un onglet de NeoDex : l'app: Discord in a NeoDex tab: the official web app, with servers, direct messages, calls and screen sharing. You sign in once, unread private messages and mentions show on the tab and on the icon of the left bar, even with the tab closed, with a notification for each new message, notifications go through site permissions, and the colours follow your theme (can be turned off in Settings → Appearance). NeoDex reads nothing from your account.
Rien n'est synchronisé : la connexion re: Nothing is synchronized: the connection remains on each PC.
Un nouveau message privé ou une mention: A new private message or mention on Discord.
